sessions.title: LONDON JAM
sessions.details:
https://www.eventbrite.com/e/1990466643312?aff=oddtdtcreator


A CI jam to bring everyone together: London's CI teachers, organisers and you, the wider community for a time out to dance, lab and connect.


26th: Saturday 16:00 - 22:00

27th: Sunday 11:00-17:00


Our teaching and organising community is the foundation of London's CI community.
We want to celebrate being here together and meet you as a community, not just as individual practitioners.

Join us for one or two days of dancing, where you can fully let go—fall, fly, and be caught by the fabric of long-term, lush CI practices that our community holds. Experience CI as life integration where body meets mind and generates a collective field of care, curiosity and spirit.

We enter with as little agenda as possible, honouring the present moment that improvisation and jamming invite. Each day will be centred around spacious jams in the large Walworth Hall. Adjacent areas—the kitchen, living room, chill-out space and courtyard—give us room to chat, eat, rest, dream, and flow.

As our dancing and teaching community grows in size, practices, wisdom, and challenges, this event offers us a chance to jam our way into sensing who we are now and how we step into the future together.

Before and during the event, you are invited to share any questions you have about CI—technical, visionary, reflective, or concerning needs or serious concerns. We will dedicate 1.5 hours each day for teachers to explore these questions in small, spontaneous labs that you’re welcome to join on the spot.

And that’s really all there is to it!

This event is for people who consider CI an ongoing practice and who want to connect with the wider community through shared research and continuous exploration.

Please bring your own food. A microwave, cups, tea, and basic kitchen essentials are available to support your day.

In this gentle workshop, we’ll offer simple, playful ways to connect through movement. Contact Improvisation, also called CI, can include touch, sharing weight, or dynamic motion, but we will keep everything light, optional, and based on comfort.

We want this event to be accessible to all abilities, ages and backgrounds.

sessions.title: "SENSATIONAL MOVES": 9 -12 April . 4 DAY INTENSIVE Feldenkrais, Movement Exploration & CI with Simonetta Alessandri & Thomas Kampe
sessions.details: Room 154, Richard Hoggart Building, Goldsmiths, Lewisham Way, London, SE14 6NW • 9 -12 April 4 day Intensive exploring somatic dance practice, Feldenkrais Method and Contact Improvisation. In this four-day workshop, we combine somatic movement principles of the Feldenkrais Method® with dance exploration & Contact Improvisation practice. In the morning sessions we will be using ‘Awareness Through Movement’® lessons and touch-based explorations. We will focus on solo explorations and will connect with our core and imagination, deepening our felt sense of gravity and grounding. Through Dance Improvisational practice we will develop our observation skills and individual creative agency to integrate our embodied discoveries, fostering creative risk-taking and playfulness. In the afternoon sessions we will expand these explorations into the practice of Contact Improvisation to enhance our ability to interact and communicate expressively and playfully with ease and clarity. Drawing on our felt sense and somatic attunement through touch and gravity, we will revisit and refine Contact Improvisation skills and creative vocabularies, such as weight exchange, balance, support and lifts with a partner and in small ensemble situations. Each day we will take time to discuss or write reflectively about our personal and somatic discoveries. The Feldenkrais Method®, developed by Dr. Moshe Feldenkrais (1904-1984) is a gentle, embodied process focused on self-discovery, embodied thinking, creative wellbeing, and functional improvement. It invites participants to slow down, listen to internal sensations, and create new neural pathways that support creative choice making in action. This workshop is open to anyone interested in deepening their dance or movement practice. Thomas and Simonetta have been teaching Feldenkrais-informed dance classes around the globe for over 20 years and are world-leading researchers and artists in the field. Dr.Thomas Kampe (PhD) (he/him) has worked as a performer, artist, researcher and somatic educator across the globe for 40 years and was ‘Professor of Somatic Performance and Education’ at Bath Spa University (UK) between 2012 and 2022. Thomas initially trained in visual art and dance and is a teacher of the Feldenkrais Method ® which forms a rich foundation for his teaching, arts practice and research. He is interested in critical somatic arts legacies and his writings and performance works have been published internationally. He was editor of the Feldenkrais Research Journal Vol. 6 ‘Practices of Freedom: The Feldenkrais Method & Creativity’ in 2019, and recently co-edited JDSP Vol. 13.1 & 2 (2022): ‘Embodying Eco-Consciousness: Somatics, Aesthetic Practice and Social Action’. Simonetta Alessandri is an Italian dance artist & somatic educator based in London. She applies the Feldenkrais Method in dance & movement training and in performance making. She teaches at Trinity Laban, Goldsmiths University and London Contemporary Dance School. Her work is informed by more than 30 years of dancing, teaching and choreographing. Her choreography has been for dance companies, student pieces, large scale opera, improvised performance, site specific and movement direction for theatre. She was one of the few dance practitioners in Italy who began working with CI in the 90’s. She has been a guest teacher in Germany, Colombia, UK, Norway, Israel, France, Switzerland, Italy, Poland, Spain and Taiwan. She obtained the Post Graduate Diploma at London Contemporary Dance School; she is a qualified teacher of the Feldenkrais Method and she holds the Teacher Certificate of the Royal Academy of Dance. She is a founder member of CI@Goldsmiths London. https://bookwhen.com/cigoldsmiths/e/ev-swh5j-20260409100000

In this workshop, we will explore how inversions in contact can open up your range and play in contact improvisation. Overall it is a workshop for experienced dancers who are looking to become more comfortable in their upside down practice and who like to increase risk in their dancing safely. That means we will also look at falls and jumps to incorporate more dynamic weight shifts. We will take time to prepare the body and develop a deeper understanding of recovery, safety, and freedom in movement as we go along for a strong yet mindful practice to emerge.

sessions.title: "SENSATIONAL MOVES": 9 -12 April . 4 DAY INTENSIVE Feldenkrais, Movement Exploration & CI with Simonetta Alessandri & Thomas Kampe
sessions.details: Room 154, Richard Hoggart Building, Goldsmiths, Lewisham Way, London, SE14 6NW • 9 -12 April 4 day Intensive exploring somatic dance practice, Feldenkrais Method and Contact Improvisation. In this four-day workshop, we combine somatic movement principles of the Feldenkrais Method® with dance exploration & Contact Improvisation practice. In the morning sessions we will be using ‘Awareness Through Movement’® lessons and touch-based explorations. We will focus on solo explorations and will connect with our core and imagination, deepening our felt sense of gravity and grounding. Through Dance Improvisational practice we will develop our observation skills and individual creative agency to integrate our embodied discoveries, fostering creative risk-taking and playfulness. In the afternoon sessions we will expand these explorations into the practice of Contact Improvisation to enhance our ability to interact and communicate expressively and playfully with ease and clarity. Drawing on our felt sense and somatic attunement through touch and gravity, we will revisit and refine Contact Improvisation skills and creative vocabularies, such as weight exchange, balance, support and lifts with a partner and in small ensemble situations. Each day we will take time to discuss or write reflectively about our personal and somatic discoveries. The Feldenkrais Method®, developed by Dr. Moshe Feldenkrais (1904-1984) is a gentle, embodied process focused on self-discovery, embodied thinking, creative wellbeing, and functional improvement. It invites participants to slow down, listen to internal sensations, and create new neural pathways that support creative choice making in action. This workshop is open to anyone interested in deepening their dance or movement practice. Thomas and Simonetta have been teaching Feldenkrais-informed dance classes around the globe for over 20 years and are world-leading researchers and artists in the field. Dr.Thomas Kampe (PhD) (he/him) has worked as a performer, artist, researcher and somatic educator across the globe for 40 years and was ‘Professor of Somatic Performance and Education’ at Bath Spa University (UK) between 2012 and 2022. Thomas initially trained in visual art and dance and is a teacher of the Feldenkrais Method ® which forms a rich foundation for his teaching, arts practice and research. He is interested in critical somatic arts legacies and his writings and performance works have been published internationally. He was editor of the Feldenkrais Research Journal Vol. 6 ‘Practices of Freedom: The Feldenkrais Method & Creativity’ in 2019, and recently co-edited JDSP Vol. 13.1 & 2 (2022): ‘Embodying Eco-Consciousness: Somatics, Aesthetic Practice and Social Action’. Simonetta Alessandri is an Italian dance artist & somatic educator based in London. She applies the Feldenkrais Method in dance & movement training and in performance making. She teaches at Trinity Laban, Goldsmiths University and London Contemporary Dance School. Her work is informed by more than 30 years of dancing, teaching and choreographing. Her choreography has been for dance companies, student pieces, large scale opera, improvised performance, site specific and movement direction for theatre. She was one of the few dance practitioners in Italy who began working with CI in the 90’s. She has been a guest teacher in Germany, Colombia, UK, Norway, Israel, France, Switzerland, Italy, Poland, Spain and Taiwan. She obtained the Post Graduate Diploma at London Contemporary Dance School; she is a qualified teacher of the Feldenkrais Method and she holds the Teacher Certificate of the Royal Academy of Dance. She is a founder member of CI@Goldsmiths London. https://bookwhen.com/cigoldsmiths/e/ev-swh5j-20260409100000

sessions.title: Casino Libre
sessions.details: Casino (Cuban Salsa) Partnerwork Classes Mondays | 6:00–11:00 PM Drop-in classes 6:00pm – Beginners Class 7:15pm – Intro to casino + Casino Improvers 8:30pm – Casino Improvers + Casino Basics 9:30pm – Free Social Join us for a focused evening of Casino (Cuban Salsa) partnerwork, dedicated to building strong foundations, clean technique, and confident social dancing all rooted in authentic Cuban style. These drop-in classes are designed to support dancers at different stages, with three progressive levels running back-to-back so you can join exactly where you feel comfortable. Class Structure Intro: For beginners and those new to Casino. Learn the essential basics of Cuban partnerwork, connection, flow, and movement in a friendly, supportive environment. Improvers: For dancers with some experience. Strengthen your foundations, refine technique, and develop better flow, timing, and partner communication. Basics. For confident dancers ready to deepen their skills. Explore more complex partnerwork, musical interpretation, variation, and technique with a strong focus on clarity, control, and social usability. What to Expect Clear, structured teaching Strong emphasis on correct Casino technique Partner rotation (no need to bring a partner change partners) A relaxed but focused atmosphere Practical material you can use immediately on the social dance floor Our approach prioritises quality over quantity, helping you build a solid technical base while staying true to the social, playful spirit of Cuban dance. Whether you’re just starting out or looking to sharpen your skills, these classes offer a consistent space to learn, practice, and grow.

sessions.address: Coal Drops Yard, King's Cross, London
sessions.title: Rueda Libre Wednesday + Libre Class • Rueda with High Five Salsa•
sessions.details: This week, we’re celebrating the legendary Buena Vista Social Club. We’re delighted to be partnering with Buena Vista Social Club as they celebrate 30 years of their iconic self-titled album, Buena Vista Social Club. Get ready to enjoy timeless favourites including Chan Chan, Candela, El Cuarto de Tula and many more, all brought to life in a special evening of Cuban music, rhythm and dance. Find out more here https://BuenaVistaSocialClub.lnk.to/RuedaLibre Get ready to dance, learn, meet amazing people, and embrace the joy of salsa dancing! Our outdoor salsa event is the perfect place to spice up your evening, whether you’re a seasoned pro or have never danced a step in your life. Here’s what to expect: Cuban Salsa and Rueda Classes: We’re offering classes for all levels, from absolute beginners to advanced dancers. No partner? No problem! Everyone is welcome to join in the fun. Visit https://ruedalibre.co.uk/classes/ to find out which class level suits you best. Class Time: Classes kick off at 7:00 PM, but make sure to arrive by 6:45 PM to show your QR code and collect your wristband. This ensures you’re ready and wont miss the beginning of the class. Free Outdoor Social Dancing: After the class, the night doesn’t end! Stick around for some free outdoor social dancing. Practice your moves, connect with the community, and just let loose. The vibe is 10/10 so enjoy it. Affordable Pricing: Classes start at just £9 (excluding fees), and you’ll have the chance to practice what you’ve learned during the session. The most budget-friendly way to pay is via our QR code in person, no fees to worry about. Prefer other options? We also accept cash, contactless payments, and online payments for your convenience. Libre Class: These classes are designed to expose you to the wider Cuban culture. In addition to this, they are formatted in a way that you can walk away from the class with something concrete. Entry level/requirements: 25-30 Classes of Rueda. Rueda Plus Level Whether you’re a salsa enthusiast or simply looking for a new experience, this is your chance to dance, laugh, and create unforgettable memories. Join us and make the most of your Wednesday evening. We move to the front of Kings Cross station (Euston road) at 9pm. Please be aware this is subject to circumstance. Ready to dance? Grab your spot and let’s make this a night to remember. See you there!

sessions.title: Rueda Night
sessions.details: Come and join a fun and friendly worldwide community of Rueda de Casino dancers 🛞🕺💃🏻 Bournemouth has a dedicated Rueda de Casino night 🥳 To begin with there are 2 levels of classes: ** 7:30pm Rueda Flow 💨 ** For those of us obsessed with how far we can push the rueda game. This is a closed group for regular rueda de casino dancers, please message to express interest and to receive an invite. (Arrival from 7:15pm) ** 8:30pm Rueda FUNdamentals 🤩 ** This is suitable for ALL levels of rueda dancers to practise their skills (but you must dance salsa)! We will cover the core moves needed to join social ruedas, with a focus on fun, including calls not used in the Flow class. We will also introduce a partnerwork move each week to improve your social dancing repertoire! (Arrival from 8:15pm ** 9:15pm Salsa only social ** No partner or booking needed (but an invite is needed for the Flow group, and the timing of Flow can change when beginner’s courses are running). 💷 £8 for one class, £12 for both.

sessions.title: Baila Urbana Thursday Salsa Night
sessions.details: Not just another salsa night… ✨ Presented by Baila Urbana 💜, experience one of London’s most unique outdoor summer dance events 🤝 Enjoy a FULLY FREE evening featuring Timba Británica, a full live Cuban band performing from a floating stage on the water, creating an unforgettable atmosphere as the sun sets over Canada Water 🌅🎶🇨🇺 Throughout the evening, FREE beginners salsa classes run between the band’s live sets, with plenty of social dancing before, during and after the music, all outdoors by the water 💃🕺 Whether it’s your very first dance or your hundredth, everyone is welcome 💜 📍 Canada Water, by Corner Corner 🌿 Outdoor waterfront venue 🕕 Every Thursday from 6:00pm 🎶 Live music by Timba Británica (until 8:30pm*) 🆓 Everything is completely FREE *If we’re given the green light, we’ll keep the evening going with an impromptu salsa social after the band finishes 👀 Stay tuned! #BU2BU 💜

sessions.title: Alafia Afro-Cuban Dance Festival Welcome Party – Music Night
sessions.details: fro-Cuban Music Night and Alafia Afro-Cuban Dance Festival Welcome Party Friday 4th September | 19:00 – 23:00 The Castle, 44 Commercial Road, E1 (near Whitechapel/Aldgate Tube Stations) The ACMN is an evening of drumming, singing and dancing, featuring Batá, Orisha music, Rumba, and other Afro-Cuban folkloric music. An informal and inclusive gathering where musicians, dancers and music lovers come together to share these traditions. This is not a concert — everyone who attends is encouraged to take part in some way, depending on their experience and confidence. This month we’re hosting the night in partnership with Alafia Afro-Cuban Dance Festival 2026 for their opening night welcome party and fundraising for Cuba Vive. We’ll have special guests Yandra Pau and Samson Frankie leading an open dance class, as well as master musicians Gerardo de Armas (Cuba), Yusniel Martinez (Cuba), Gwenael Francotte (Belgium), Alafia founder and master dancer Luanda Pau (Cuba), and many more fantastic performers from Cuba and London there. This long-running tradition — a free night of Afro-Cuban music in London — has been going for over twenty years. Come and be part of its legacy. For more information about Alafia Afro-Cuban Dance Festival (location, schedule, tickets) head to @alafiafestival.uk

sessions.title: Casino Libre
sessions.details: Casino (Cuban Salsa) Partnerwork Classes Mondays | 6:00–11:00 PM Drop-in classes 6:00pm – Beginners Class 7:15pm – Intro to casino + Casino Improvers 8:30pm – Casino Improvers + Casino Basics 9:30pm – Free Social Join us for a focused evening of Casino (Cuban Salsa) partnerwork, dedicated to building strong foundations, clean technique, and confident social dancing all rooted in authentic Cuban style. These drop-in classes are designed to support dancers at different stages, with three progressive levels running back-to-back so you can join exactly where you feel comfortable. Class Structure Intro: For beginners and those new to Casino. Learn the essential basics of Cuban partnerwork, connection, flow, and movement in a friendly, supportive environment. Improvers: For dancers with some experience. Strengthen your foundations, refine technique, and develop better flow, timing, and partner communication. Basics. For confident dancers ready to deepen their skills. Explore more complex partnerwork, musical interpretation, variation, and technique with a strong focus on clarity, control, and social usability. What to Expect Clear, structured teaching Strong emphasis on correct Casino technique Partner rotation (no need to bring a partner change partners) A relaxed but focused atmosphere Practical material you can use immediately on the social dance floor Our approach prioritises quality over quantity, helping you build a solid technical base while staying true to the social, playful spirit of Cuban dance. Whether you’re just starting out or looking to sharpen your skills, these classes offer a consistent space to learn, practice, and grow.

sessions.title: Queer Salsa: Beginners Cuban & Rueda (5 Week Course)
sessions.details: A 5-week progressive Cuban Salsa course, covering footwork, body movement, partner-work with a special focus on the group partner dance: Rueda de Casino. TICKETS HERE 📅 Dates: the following 5 Thursdays: 10/9, 17/9, 24/9, 1/10 and 8/10 🕗 Time: 19:00–21:00 (Arrive 18:45 ) 📍 Location: Bishopsgate Institute, 230 Bishopsgate, London EC2M 4QH ➕Each class followed by a free optional social 21:00-23:00 at different location 💸 Reduced Cost Spots at £45 and Free Spots A small number of reduced-cost places are prioritised for: Queer Black and/or Latinx people People on Universal Credit (or similar benefits) Those on minimum wage or low income We also offer 2 free spots for: People seeking asylum People in precarious situations without access to public funds Spots are limited and offered on a first-come, first-served basis. 💌 Contact us: hello@queersalsa.co.uk 💙 Suitable for complete beginners & beyond It’s ideal if you’re completely new to Cuban Salsa, returning after a break, coming from another Salsa or Afro-Latin style, or exploring a new dance role. If you already have experience in Cuban Salsa, we’ll offer optional variations on the core material to keep things engaging. You’re also welcome to get in touch about volunteering as a Guardian Dancer, attending classes for free and offering extra 1:1 support where needed. 💙 What you’ll learn Core Rhythms, Timings and Footwork of Cuban Salsa and Rueda Key Principles of Leading/Following Foundational partner moves of Cuban Salsa & Rueda How to Social Dance and Improvise This is a progressive course, so each week will be building on from the other. This course might not be suitable if you know you are likely to miss more than one session. Each class is roughly split into thirds: footwork and timing; partnerwork; and Rueda de Casino. 💙 Week by week breakdown If you are a complete beginner and don’t know what any of these mean don’t worry you will learn on the course! 10/09 Week 1: Foundational Rhythms & Dile Que No 17/09 Week 2: Enchufla & Enchufla Doble 24/09 Week 3: Sácala & Adios 01/10 Week 4: Prima, Hermana y la Familia 08/10 Week 5: Vacilala & Dile Que Si

sessions.title: Agua Salsa Festival
sessions.details: Agua Salsa Festival is more than just a dance event — it’s a celebration of music, culture, connection, and pure energy that has united dancers from around the world year after year. ​ From our very first edition to today, Agua has grown into a vibrant meeting point where Cuban salsa, Afro-Cuban rhythms, and a touch of bachata come alive in the heart of Thessaloniki. ​ Held in one of Greece’s most dynamic cities, each edition of the festival has transformed Thessaloniki into a buzzing hub of workshops, parties, boat adventures, and unforgettable moments. With world-class DJs, inspiring instructors, and an international community, Agua continues to be the ultimate destination for dancers of all levels who come to share their passion and create lifelong memories. ​ Take a journey through the years — watch our aftermovies and relive the magic of every edition!

These drop-in classes are designed to support dancers at different stages, with three progressive levels running back-to-back so you can join exactly where you feel comfortable. Class Structure Intro: For beginners and those new to Casino. Learn the essential basics of Cuban partnerwork, connection, flow, and movement in a friendly, supportive environment. Improvers: For dancers with some experience. Strengthen your foundations, refine technique, and develop better flow, timing, and partner communication. Basics. For confident dancers ready to deepen their skills. Explore more complex partnerwork, musical interpretation, variation, and technique with a strong focus on clarity, control, and social usability. What to Expect Clear, structured teaching Strong emphasis on correct Casino technique Partner rotation (no need to bring a partner change partners) A relaxed but focused atmosphere Practical material you can use immediately on the social dance floor Our approach prioritises quality over quantity, helping you build a solid technical base while staying true to the social, playful spirit of Cuban dance. Whether you’re just starting out or looking to sharpen your skills, these classes offer a consistent space to learn, practice, and grow.

sessions.title: Rueda Libre Wednesday
sessions.details: Join Us for an Unforgettable Outdoor Cuban Salsa Event! Get ready to dance, learn, meet amazing people, and embrace the joy of salsa dancing! Our outdoor salsa event is the perfect place to spice up your evening, whether you’re a seasoned pro or have never danced a step in your life. Here’s what to expect: Cuban Salsa and Rueda Classes: We’re offering classes for all levels, from absolute beginners to advanced dancers. No partner? No problem! Everyone is welcome to join in the fun. Visit https://ruedalibre.co.uk/classes/ to find out which class level suits you best. Class Time: Classes kick off at 7:00 PM, but make sure to arrive by 6:45 PM to show your QR code and collect your wristband. This ensures you’re ready and wont miss the beginning of the class. Free Outdoor Social Dancing: After the class, the night doesn’t end! Stick around for some free outdoor social dancing. Practice your moves, connect with the community, and just let loose. The vibe is 10/10 so enjoy it. Affordable Pricing: Classes start at just £9 (excluding fees), and you’ll have the chance to practice what you’ve learned during the session. The most budget-friendly way to pay is via our QR code in person, no fees to worry about. Prefer other options? We also accept cash, contactless payments, and online payments for your convenience. Whether you’re a salsa enthusiast or simply looking for a new experience, this is your chance to dance, laugh, and create unforgettable memories. Join us and make the most of your Wednesday evening. Ready to dance? Grab your spot and let’s make this a night to remember. See you there!

sessions.title: Rueda Night
sessions.details: Come and join a fun and friendly worldwide community of Rueda de Casino dancers 🛞🕺💃🏻 Bournemouth has a dedicated Rueda de Casino night 🥳 To begin with there are 2 levels of classes: ** 7:30pm Rueda Flow 💨 ** For those of us obsessed with how far we can push the rueda game. This is a closed group for regular rueda de casino dancers, please message to express interest and to receive an invite. (Arrival from 7:15pm) ** 8:30pm Rueda FUNdamentals 🤩 ** This is suitable for ALL levels of rueda dancers to practise their skills (but you must dance salsa)! We will cover the core moves needed to join social ruedas, with a focus on fun, including calls not used in the Flow class. We will also introduce a partnerwork move each week to improve your social dancing repertoire! (Arrival from 8:15pm ** 9:15pm Salsa only social ** No partner or booking needed (but an invite is needed for the Flow group, and the timing of Flow can change when beginner’s courses are running). 💷 £8 for one class, £12 for both.

sessions.title: Festival Rueda GlobeTrotters
sessions.details: https://www.instagram.com/festivalruedaglobetrotters http://www.rgtfestival.com/ The RGT Festival (Festival Rueda GlobeTrotters) is a weekend dance festival dedicated to Rueda de Casino — a Cuban group salsa dance — along with salsa workshops, social parties, and competitions. 9th-11th October 2026 Festival Focus & Highlights 💃 Rueda de Casino: The core of the festival is Rueda de Casino — Cuban circle partner salsa — celebrated as a communal and joyful dance style. This festival puts it at the heart of classes, social dancing, and competitions. 🎓 Workshops: Intensive dance classes throughout Saturday and Sunday. Sessions include technique, rueda patterns, Cuban salsa styling, and group routines. 🎉 Social Dancing & Parties: Evening parties with DJs playing salsa, Cuban, and Latin music. Before-party events and themed social dance sessions each night. 🏆 Shows & Competitions: Rueda de Casino competitions and showcases featuring participants and instructors.

sessions.title: Crazy 4 La Timba 2026
sessions.details: Crazy 4 La Timba is more than just a festival – it is a family! Smiles, friendship and non-stop dancing. That is the spirit of C4LT. Join our amazing community in beautiful Lisbon in October 15-18, 2026, for an experience that will fill your heart. Get ready to soak the sunshine and feel the ocean breeze in a city that is perfect for our Cuban dance getaway. From intensive bootcamps and inspiring workshops to legendary parties that last all night. C4LT is your chance to learn from the best, connect with dancers from all over the world, and create memories that will last a lifetime. Whether you are a seasoned dancer or just starting your journey, this festival is for everyone who has passion for Timba and Cuban culture, regardless of your dance level. We create a welcoming space for all to learn, grow and celebrate together. Check our our main venues – the iconic Timeout Market and the renowned Jazzy dance Studios are conveniently located within walking distance from each other. Get more information or your ticket on our website crazy4latimba.com and follow us on instagram @crazy4latimba. We are happy to see you in October!

sessions.title: Rueda Libre Wednesday
sessions.details: Join Us for an Unforgettable Outdoor Cuban Salsa Event! Get ready to dance, learn, meet amazing people, and embrace the joy of salsa dancing! Our outdoor salsa event is the perfect place to spice up your evening, whether you’re a seasoned pro or have never danced a step in your life. Here’s what to expect: Cuban Salsa and Rueda Classes: We’re offering classes for all levels, from absolute beginners to advanced dancers. No partner? No problem! Everyone is welcome to join in the fun. Visit https://ruedalibre.co.uk/classes/ to find out which class level suits you best. Class Time: Classes kick off at 7:00 PM, but make sure to arrive by 6:45 PM to show your QR code and collect your wristband. This ensures you’re ready and wont miss the beginning of the class. Free Outdoor Social Dancing: After the class, the night doesn’t end! Stick around for some free outdoor social dancing. Practice your moves, connect with the community, and just let loose. The vibe is 10/10 so enjoy it. Affordable Pricing: Classes start at just £9 (excluding fees), and you’ll have the chance to practice what you’ve learned during the session. The most budget-friendly way to pay is via our QR code in person, no fees to worry about. Prefer other options? We also accept cash, contactless payments, and online payments for your convenience. Whether you’re a salsa enthusiast or simply looking for a new experience, this is your chance to dance, laugh, and create unforgettable memories. Join us and make the most of your Wednesday evening. Ready to dance? Grab your spot and let’s make this a night to remember. See you there!

sessions.title: Rueda Night
sessions.details: Come and join a fun and friendly worldwide community of Rueda de Casino dancers 🛞🕺💃🏻 Bournemouth has a dedicated Rueda de Casino night 🥳 To begin with there are 2 levels of classes: ** 7:30pm Rueda Flow 💨 ** For those of us obsessed with how far we can push the rueda game. This is a closed group for regular rueda de casino dancers, please message to express interest and to receive an invite. (Arrival from 7:15pm) ** 8:30pm Rueda FUNdamentals 🤩 ** This is suitable for ALL levels of rueda dancers to practise their skills (but you must dance salsa)! We will cover the core moves needed to join social ruedas, with a focus on fun, including calls not used in the Flow class. We will also introduce a partnerwork move each week to improve your social dancing repertoire! (Arrival from 8:15pm ** 9:15pm Salsa only social ** No partner or booking needed (but an invite is needed for the Flow group, and the timing of Flow can change when beginner’s courses are running). 💷 £8 for one class, £12 for both.

sessions.title: Casino Libre
sessions.details: Casino (Cuban Salsa) Partnerwork Classes Mondays | 6:00–11:00 PM Drop-in classes 6:00pm – Beginners Class 7:15pm – Intro to casino + Casino Improvers 8:30pm – Casino Improvers + Casino Basics 9:30pm – Free Social Join us for a focused evening of Casino (Cuban Salsa) partnerwork, dedicated to building strong foundations, clean technique, and confident social dancing all rooted in authentic Cuban style. These drop-in classes are designed to support dancers at different stages, with three progressive levels running back-to-back so you can join exactly where you feel comfortable. Class Structure Intro: For beginners and those new to Casino. Learn the essential basics of Cuban partnerwork, connection, flow, and movement in a friendly, supportive environment. Improvers: For dancers with some experience. Strengthen your foundations, refine technique, and develop better flow, timing, and partner communication. Basics. For confident dancers ready to deepen their skills. Explore more complex partnerwork, musical interpretation, variation, and technique with a strong focus on clarity, control, and social usability. What to Expect Clear, structured teaching Strong emphasis on correct Casino technique Partner rotation (no need to bring a partner change partners) A relaxed but focused atmosphere Practical material you can use immediately on the social dance floor Our approach prioritises quality over quantity, helping you build a solid technical base while staying true to the social, playful spirit of Cuban dance. Whether you’re just starting out or looking to sharpen your skills, these classes offer a consistent space to learn, practice, and grow.

sessions.title: Duke – Dance UK Evolution
sessions.details: D.U.K.E is an exciting event bringing a unique and powerful experience that will remain with the dancer for a lifetime. We are dedicated to ensuring the highest quality and lot of fun! For us, we have made a real family through dance with deep and meaningful connections. Not only do we plan to share our family with you but share the family feel with you. “The dance scene has given me an incredible adventure I could never imagine and after this amazing journey I wanted to give back to the dance community. Therefore, I partnered with my friend Massimo Mazzocca to bring you the greats that inspired me to inspire others, all the dancers / DJs / musicians / organisers etc that became part of my family as well as the best from the next generation. Let’s share the love.” – MOE FLEX

sessions.title: Latin Kiss Tuesdays Classes & Social
sessions.details: 💃Ready to spice up your Tuesdays? 🌶️🔥 🎉 Join us at LatinKiss for an unforgettable salsa experience! Whether you’re a beginner or already have some moves, our classes are packed with energy, passion, and fun. 💃🕺 💥 What to expect: 💥 ✅ Fun and energetic atmosphere ✅ Easy-to-follow instructions ✅ Exciting routines and footwork ✅ Partner work and social dancing ✅ Boosted confidence and fitness while having the time of your life—without even noticing! 🗓️ Mark your calendars: 📅 Date: TUESDAYS 🚪 Doors open: 7:30pm ⏰ Classes: 8pm – 9pm 💃 Social: 9pm – 11pm 📍 Location: The Winchmore – N21 1QA ✨ Don’t miss out—grab your dancing shoes and join the hottest salsa scene in town! ✨

sessions.title: Rueda Night
sessions.details: Come and join a fun and friendly worldwide community of Rueda de Casino dancers 🛞🕺💃🏻 Bournemouth has a dedicated Rueda de Casino night 🥳 To begin with there are 2 levels of classes: ** 7:30pm Rueda Flow 💨 ** For those of us obsessed with how far we can push the rueda game. This is a closed group for regular rueda de casino dancers, please message to express interest and to receive an invite. (Arrival from 7:15pm) ** 8:30pm Rueda FUNdamentals 🤩 ** This is suitable for ALL levels of rueda dancers to practise their skills (but you must dance salsa)! We will cover the core moves needed to join social ruedas, with a focus on fun, including calls not used in the Flow class. We will also introduce a partnerwork move each week to improve your social dancing repertoire! (Arrival from 8:15pm ** 9:15pm Salsa only social ** No partner or booking needed (but an invite is needed for the Flow group, and the timing of Flow can change when beginner’s courses are running). 💷 £8 for one class, £12 for both.

sessions.title: Cubaneando saturday workshop
sessions.details: ★SATURDAYS INFO: If you booked for Saturday you have already paid online Remember there are 10h & 12h Bundles available for £60 depending on your level. sessions.title: Cubaneando saturday workshop
sessions.details: ★SATURDAYS INFO: If you booked for Saturday you have already paid online Remember there are 10h & 12h Bundles available for £60 depending on your level. We’re hosting an exciting night of intensive salsa courses and free social dancing at the O2 Shopping Centre on Finchley Road. Join us from 5 PM to 8 PM for classes, and then keep the energy going with free dancing from 8 PM to 11:30 PM. It’s a great opportunity to hone your skills and connect with our lively salsa community! Everyone is welcome, whether you join the lessons or just want to dance. Plus, don’t forget to check out the nearby restaurants and supermarkets to complete your night—there’s even 2 hours of free parking when you shop at Sainsbury’s!

sessions.title: Salsa Secrets Classes & Social
sessions.details: 🌟 SUNDAYS ARE FOR SALSA SECRETS 🌟 💃 The longest-running salsa school in North London – over 30 years of rhythm, passion & community! This isn’t just a class. It’s an experience. The music, the people, the energy — Sunday nights belong to Salsa Secrets. 📍 652 Hertford Road, Enfield, EN3 6LZ 🕗 Classes start 8PM sharp – arrive early, feel the buzz 🎉 Social dancing until late – dance, connect, celebrate 💨 Fully air-conditioned – cool comfort, hot moves 🍹 Bar open all night – drinks, laughter & good times 🎵 The best Cuban beats – non-stop energy on the floor ✨ Your teaching team: Elliot Johnson Mia Suarez Carlton Thomas 🔥 Why Salsa Secrets? Legendary vibes & welcoming community The ultimate Sunday night workout (without it feeling like one) A salsa family like no other 👯‍♂️ Bring a partner — or come alone! No partner needed. ❤️ Every Sunday is special. But tonight? Unmissable. 👉 Tag your dance partner (or future one!) 👉 Bring your friends 👉 Or just bring yourself — you’ll be part of the family from the first step #salsa #cuba #sunday #northlondon #dance

sessions.title: Latin Kiss Tuesdays Classes & Social
sessions.details: 💃Ready to spice up your Tuesdays? 🌶️🔥 🎉 Join us at LatinKiss for an unforgettable salsa experience! Whether you’re a beginner or already have some moves, our classes are packed with energy, passion, and fun. 💃🕺 💥 What to expect: 💥 ✅ Fun and energetic atmosphere ✅ Easy-to-follow instructions ✅ Exciting routines and footwork ✅ Partner work and social dancing ✅ Boosted confidence and fitness while having the time of your life—without even noticing! 🗓️ Mark your calendars: 📅 Date: TUESDAYS 🚪 Doors open: 7:30pm ⏰ Classes: 8pm – 9pm 💃 Social: 9pm – 11pm 📍 Location: The Winchmore – N21 1QA ✨ Don’t miss out—grab your dancing shoes and join the hottest salsa scene in town! ✨

sessions.title: Rueda Night
sessions.details: Come and join a fun and friendly worldwide community of Rueda de Casino dancers 🛞🕺💃🏻 Bournemouth has a dedicated Rueda de Casino night 🥳 To begin with there are 2 levels of classes: ** 7:30pm Rueda Flow 💨 ** For those of us obsessed with how far we can push the rueda game. This is a closed group for regular rueda de casino dancers, please message to express interest and to receive an invite. (Arrival from 7:15pm) ** 8:30pm Rueda FUNdamentals 🤩 ** This is suitable for ALL levels of rueda dancers to practise their skills (but you must dance salsa)! We will cover the core moves needed to join social ruedas, with a focus on fun, including calls not used in the Flow class. We will also introduce a partnerwork move each week to improve your social dancing repertoire! (Arrival from 8:15pm ** 9:15pm Salsa only social ** No partner or booking needed (but an invite is needed for the Flow group, and the timing of Flow can change when beginner’s courses are running). 💷 £8 for one class, £12 for both.

We’re hosting an exciting night of intensive salsa courses and free social dancing at the O2 Shopping Centre on Finchley Road. Join us from 5 PM to 8 PM for classes, and then keep the energy going with free dancing from 8 PM to 11:30 PM. It’s a great opportunity to hone your skills and connect with our lively salsa community! Everyone is welcome, whether you join the lessons or just want to dance. We’ll be grooving on Level 2 near the seating area, so come on down! Plus, don’t forget to check out the nearby restaurants and supermarkets to complete your night—there’s even 2 hours of free parking when you shop at Sainsbury’s!

sessions.address: Miraflores Bar & Lounge, 60 Southwark Street, London
sessions.title: Cubaneando Tuesday
sessions.details: Payment for the sessions will be collected by cash at the door, However, you can still pay by card for your drinks at the Bar and the cloakroom. TUESDAY’S PRICES: (Classes only) FREE – from 6:30pm to 7pm £10 for 1h or £15 if you do 2h – £2 off for Students and NHS staff only when booking for 2 classes Cuban Salsa 7 & 8:15pm (2 levels each) with Esther Alvero & Antonio de Freitas Price: £15 for 2h Phone: + 0795 018 4131

For our terms and conditions click here.If you have any questions or technical issues call 020 7629 6183 or email membership@danceworks.com.CLASS DESCRIPTIONThe classes are geared to help dancers maintain and further their technique, strengthen the core centre, work on their musicality and speed while at the same time investigate and explore deeper level of their artistry. The class is based on the Russian ballet style, teaching dance, musicality, and technique in a fun and engaging manner.This class is not suited for absolute beginners.Minimum age: 14 (Younger with exception, contact reception )

CLASS DESCRIPTIONAlice’s class is for those dancers with a good understanding and experience of ballet training and vocabulary. It is for those wishing to develop a greater understanding of correct placement and execution of steps alongside the essential development of performance and musicality through their class work.Alice wishes her class to be a safe place filled with love and the pure joy found through dancing. Minimum age: 13 (Younger with exception, contact reception)

sessions.details: Instructor: Dmitri Gruzdev (substitute) | Level: Intermediate | Room: Studio 2 | Location: Danceworks | Classes are bookable 7 days in advance. Concessions and packages are available.Please note if you have to cancel your booking for any reason, our cancellation policy is 24 hours for open classes , 48 hours for masterclasses . For our terms and conditions click here.If you have any questions or technical issues call 020 7629 6183 or email membership@danceworks.com.CLASS DESCRIPTION A moving class created for students with previous ballet experience and familiarity with ballet terminology. Progress through barre and center work designed to increase strength, flexibility, and technique and dance through graceful combinations. Special attention to epaulement (turning of the shoulders and upper body), correct training of the arms (port de bras), fluidity, placement, coordination with the head and all movements and precise coordination of the whole body, working as one unit.Recommended for those with around one year’s worth of knowledge of basic ballet steps or for returning students looking to go back to the basics. Minimum age: 16 (12+ as long as they have prior experience)

CLASS DESCRIPTION This class will follow the traditional structure of the codified technique, sequencing through a set series of seated floor exercises, standing exercises and across-the-floor sequences. The Graham Technique is an immensely valuable technique to layer on top of any dance training as it emphasises the importance of the usage of the back, as well as accessing the deep core abdominal muscles.Fundamental principles in Graham Technique are the contraction and release, opposition, shift of weight and spirals. Graham dancers believe that it is important that we not simply see ourselves as objects in space when dancing, but that we expand their body, energy and focus so they are amplified enough to fill that space. The class will serve to free up the back, open up the hips and the body. On top, form the dancer to find dynamics, intricacy and articulation of the spine. Minimum age: 16

Iole brings a personal touch to the ballet experience, focusing on expressiveness, musicality, coordination, and the connection between body and space. Great care is given to each dancer’s individual abilities and unique way of expressing the technique.

We’ll focus on core movements like flat backs, laterals, and T positions, then progress to Horton’s signature fortifications and studies. With repetition, clear guidance, and supportive pacing, you’ll gain confidence, strength, and artistry.

sessions.title: Contemporary Improver

You’ll play with momentum, texture, and flow, expanding coordination and expression. Open to movers with some experience, each session nurtures rhythm, body awareness, and freedom through a living dialogue of technique and artistry.

Classes will cover the fundamental concepts of the main modern and contemporary dance techniques, including release, floor work, Cunningham, and more.

sessions.title: Open Level Contemporary
sessions.details: Fridays 12:00-1:15pm w/ Chloe | Join Chloe Bowman for an energising and explorative contemporary class open to all levels. Chloe’s teaching emphasises musicality, individuality, and presence — creating a space where beginners feel supported and experienced movers can deepen their practice. Expect a thoughtful balance of structure and freedom, culminating in expansive, expressive choreography that celebrates movement in the moment.

sessions.title: Ballet Improver

sessions.title: Beginner Pointe (+Ballet Improver class prior)
sessions.details: Saturdays 1:15-1:45pm w/ Iole | Beginner Pointe is offered as a gentle extension of Ballet Improvers, designed for dancers who are ready to begin exploring pointe work in a supportive and attentive environment. This class introduces the fundamental principles of dancing en pointe at a gradual and thoughtful pace. Dancers will focus on correct alignment, strength, balance, and articulation of the feet, while deepening their understanding of placement and coordination developed in the improvers class. ​ Following the same open and reflective atmosphere, dancers are encouraged to listen closely to their bodies and progress with care and patience. Iole offers individual guidance to help each dancer build confidence, stability, and ease on pointe, while nurturing musicality and expressiveness. The emphasis is on developing strength safely, refining technique, and discovering the unique experience of dancing en pointe as a natural continuation of each dancer’s ballet journey.

sessions.title: Cuban Salsa Beginners Course
sessions.details: 📅 Dates: the following 5 Thursdays: 10/9, 17/9, 24/9, 1/10 and 8/10 🕗 Time: 19:00–21:00 (Arrive 18:45 ) • 📍 Location: Bishopsgate Institute, 230 Bishopsgate, London EC2M 4QH • ➕Each class followed by a free optional social 21:00-23:00 at different location • 💸 Reduced Cost Spots at £45 and Free Spots • A small number of reduced-cost places are prioritised for: • Queer Black and/or Latinx people • People on Universal Credit (or similar benefits) • Those on minimum wage or low income • We also offer 2 free spots for: • People seeking asylum • People in precarious situations without access to public funds • Spots are limited and offered on a first-come, first-served basis.💌 Contact us: hello@queersalsa.co.uk • It's ideal if you're completely new to Cuban Salsa, returning after a break, coming from another Salsa or Afro-Latin style, or exploring a new dance role. If you already have experience in Cuban Salsa, we'll offer optional variations on the core material to keep things engaging. You're also welcome to get in touch about volunteering as a Guardian Dancer, attending classes for free and offering extra 1:1 support where needed. • Core Rhythms, Timings and Footwork of Cuban Salsa and Rueda • Key Principles of Leading/Following • Foundational partner moves of Cuban Salsa & Rueda • How to Social Dance and Improvise • This is a progressive course, so each week will be building on from the other. This course might not be suitable if you know you are likely to miss more than one session. • Each class is roughly split into thirds: footwork and timing; partnerwork; and Rueda de Casino. • If you are a complete beginner and don’t know what any of these mean don’t worry you will learn on the course! • 10/09 Week 1: Foundational Rhythms & Dile Que No • 17/09 Week 2: Enchufla & Enchufla Doble • 24/09 Week 3: Sácala & Adios • 01/10 Week 4: Prima, Hermana y la Familia • 08/10 Week 5: Vacilala & Dile Que Si • Salsa was born in Cuba, created by enslaved African people and their descendants. Rooted in African rhythms, movement, and ways of dancing together, Salsa is a dance of joy, survival, resistance, and collective celebration. It carries histories of struggle alongside playfulness, creativity, and deep community connection. • Cuban Salsa, also known as Casino, developed in Havana's social dance halls. It's a circular, grounded style that emphasises rotation, rhythm, improvisation, and shared connection. Unlike Cross-Body Salsa, which travels along a line, Casino moves around a common center. Rueda de Casino grew out of social Casino dancing in Havana, when groups of friends began dancing together in a circle and playfully changing partners. Rueda turns salsa into a shared group experience. • Community Guidelines • Please make sure you are familiar with our community guidelines • Steps Free Access • Classes take place in the Upper Hall at Bishopsgate. The venue has step-free access via a lift, as well as accessible toilets and water points nearby. • PA’s Attend FreeJust let a member of the team know on the day when signing in to the class. • Large Cohort, Fast PaceThe class cohort will be fairly large. This course moves at a fairly high pace and is physically demanding. You're welcome to take breaks at any time, there are chairs inside the hall and quieter spaces outside if you need to step away. • Community Care Host(s) • At every class there will be a Community Care Host(s) in pink hi-vis who you can approach at any point for support related to accessibility, welfare, the venue etc. • Volunteer Guardian Dancers • More experienced dancers who join the class to give you extra support 1:1. If you already have Cuban Salsa experience and would like to join the course for free as a Volunteer Guardian Dancer check out the info on our website with the sign up process there. 💌 For any other questions or adjustments you might need, please contact us: hello@queersalsa.co.uk

sessions.title: 🌞 Queer Salsa Dance Social | Bye-bye Summer!🌞
sessions.details: Summer is ending, but the dancing never stops~A monthly beginner friendly ✨ free ✨ Queer Salsa dance social at an outdoor covered roof terrace at Untraditional Pub in Walthamstow ｡𖦹°‧ ⋆☀︎💖💌 Please sign up for a ticket, it helps us manage capacity and contact you about any changes to the event. 🌞 Complete beginner taster session from 18:45 to cover the very basics of Salsa (free)🌞 Salsa music and dancing all night🌞 Open playlist 🌞 Community-led🌞 Outdoor covered roof terrace 💖18:45 Complete Beginner salsa taster (15 minutes)During this taster, people will be given the complete basics of Crossbody Salsa to be able to have a fun time partner-dancing during our friendly social. 19:15 - 22:00 Salsa dance socialThe rest of the time, we will be dancing along to all sorts of salsa, son, mambo, and more. Show us your best moves. We are keen to see how these socials evolve over time and are open to other styles of Afro-Latin dance & music. If you want to contribute with informal teaching to support beginners and / or with actitivies at the dance social please speak to one of the community hosts who will make themselves known on the night. Venue access: Step-free entry and accessible toilets.When attending our events you are agreeing to our Community GuidelinesSee you for a lil dance hunnies 🌱💕🌻

sessions.title: Live Roda
sessions.details: Experience Capoeira in its traditional setting by taking part in a live roda.During this session we:Set up the full bateria with the eight instruments used in the Capoeira rodaPlay live Capoeira musicPractise singing and rhythmTake part in traditional Capoeira gamesThis class is an excellent opportunity to build confidence, improve your musicality, and experience the energy and traditions of Capoeira in a live setting.

sessions.title: Beginners Course - September, 8 sessions
sessions.details: This course is designed for complete beginners who are new to Capoeira or new to the London School of Capoeira. During the course, you’ll learn the basic movements and techniques of Capoeira while improving your fitness, coordination, and confidence. By the end of the course, you’ll be ready to progress to more advanced classes. • After completing the beginner course, you’ll be eligible to join our regular class • Course Details: • When: It starts from the beginning of each month and it runs 8 × 1 hour sessions. Tuesday and Thursday 7-8pm (please see note above) • Next Course: 3rd, 8th, 10th, 15th, 17th, 22nd, 24th and 29th of September • Where: London School of Capoeira, unit 1-2 Leeds Place, London N4 3RF • Clothing: Please wear comfortable tracksuit trousers and a T-shirt during this course. Shorts are not permitted. Once the course has been completed and you have joined the school, the LSCH uniform will be required.
